data.name: Melania
data.gender_notes: Melania is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word melaniosus meaning dark or melancholic. In Christianity, Saint Melania the Elder was a wealthy Roman noblewoman who renounced her wealth and dedicated her life to aiding the poor and needy. The name Melania carries the meaning “Dark, serious, or melancholic” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Melania usually hope their child will grow to embody dark, serious, or melancholic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of dedication and selflessness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Melania, originally derived from the Latin word melaniosus, has a rich cultural impact in the historical context of the Roman Empire. As a name associated with wealth and nobility, it carries an air of sophistication and elegance. However, the impact of the name was significantly altered when Melania the Elder, a Roman noblewoman, renounced her wealth and embraced a life of charity and devotion to serving the poor and needy. Her story serves as an inspiration and reminder of the transformative power of a selfless and compassionate spirit.
data.spiritual_significance: Melania is a name deeply rooted in the spiritual legacy of Christianity. The name takes its significance from Saint Melania the Elder, who is recognized for her courageous act of renouncing her wealth and dedicating her life to serving others. The spiritual meaning of Melania's name is one of sacrifice, selflessness, and devotion. It serves as a reminder of the Christian virtue of putting the needs of others before one's own, and living a life that aligns with the values of love, compassion, and service to others. The spiritual significance of this name continues to resonate with people today, inspiring them to live a life of meaning and purpose, rooted in love and compassion for their fellow human beings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Melania, meaning "black or dark" in Latin, symbolizes the depth and richness of the Christian soul, bearing the burdens of faith and the mysteries of spiritual growth in the darkest times. It is a reminder of the transformative power of God in illuminating our innermost being.
